liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Smokestack Lightning** (1 review): Praises keeping Smokestack and Spoonful together rather than splitting them, noting the two songs have similar tones [14]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 other source): Uploader labels this track as acoustic [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **Smokestack Lightning**: rare: 14 archived performances [19]
- **Spoonful**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [19]
- **Turn On Your Lovelite!**: back after 37 archived shows (365 days) [19]

## The recordings

- **dco2017-06-10.aud.flac24** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 172 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **dead2017-06-10.ccm41_flac24**: source not stated; 20 songs; 170 min; rated 4.8/5 by 5 [2]
- **DeadAndCo2017-06-10.FolsomField.TelefunkenM60.Flac24**: source not stated; 20 songs; 172 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer thinks this version has the least crowd noise, based on limited sampling [14]
- **deadco2017-06-10**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 171 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [6]

## Around the show

- Oteil joins on one marked track; Mayer sings lead on another; Jeff's sporadic vocals are hard to identify [2]
- Reviewer predicts this closing night of the Colorado run will be remembered decades on, on par with Barton Hall [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **dco2017-06-10.aud.flac24**: taped by Jeff Jansen   Texasdragonfly Productions; transferred by Jeff Jansen   Texasdragonfly Productions; source: Church Audio CA-11's (NP) (DR) > Zoom H1 Samsung EVO 16GB microSD 24/48.wav [1]
- **dead2017-06-10.ccm41_flac24**: taped by Bennett Schwartz; transferred by Coloartist; source: Schoeps ccm41>DinA>KC5>CMC6>analog>788T (HPF 0) 24/48 [2]. Also: Taped from FOB/DFC position, 40 feet back dead center, mics 7 feet high; 788t to Wavelab to FLAC [2]
- **DeadAndCo2017-06-10.FolsomField.TelefunkenM60.Flac24**: taped by bonobeats; transferred by bonobeats; source: Telefunken M60 (cards, OTS, ROC, 9' up)>Sound Devices Mixpre6 (48/24) [5]
- **deadco2017-06-10**: taped by Richie Stankiewicz; transferred by Richie Stankiewicz; source: DPA 4021/4061 Mtx, SD744T Sweet spot [6]. Also: Recorded and transferred by Richie Stankiewicz, dated 12 June 2017 [6]
